instruction: A poster_party_night.webp file was accidentally sent to Trash. Please retrieve it and place it back on Desktop with read-only permissions.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering file from Trash and setting read-only permissions. Evaluator checks file exists and has readonly permissions (no write permission for user). Custom getter checks file existence and permission bits, custom metric validates both conditions.
metadata.verification: Verified that evaluator checks: (1) file exists on Desktop, (2) file has read-only permissions (no write bit for user). Uses ls -l to check permissions and validates readonly state.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both requirements - file existence on Desktop and read-only permissions
Correct state extraction: Getter correctly checks file at target path /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp

Sound readonly logic: Uses stat -c '%a' to get octal permissions and correctly identifies readonly by checking if write bit (2) is NOT set in owner permissions using bitwise operation (owner_perm & 2) == 0
Appropriate partial credit: 50% for file existence, 50% for readonly status - sensible for this 2-step task
Correct data flow: Getter extracts file state -> Metric compares both file_exists and readonly against expected values
Edge case handling: Getter gracefully handles non-existent files by returning early with False values
